title: Smooth moving aircraft
description: Aircraft markers move between feed reports using observed position, speed and heading. Short corrections blend toward new reports rather than jumping at every refresh. Predicted markers are labeled estimated; this is not a continuous radar stream.

title: Real observation timestamps
description: Core now preserves each aircraft position timestamp and last-contact time from OpenSky. Feed observation time and fetch time are separate; a cached or newly fetched old observation is not relabeled fresh. Missing/future timestamps keep an aircraft stationary and visibly unknown.

title: Bounded and stale-data-safe movement
description: Prediction stops after 45 seconds from the position report. Aircraft fade as stale after 60 seconds and disappear after 120 seconds. Ground aircraft and invalid speed/heading values are not extrapolated. Invalid coordinates are omitted, older out-of-order reports are rejected, and missing IDs are removed on a successful new feed.

title: Animate aircraft control
description: GODSPEED Air has a named Animate aircraft checkbox. Turning it on also shows aircraft on the map; turning it off shows reported positions only. The preference stays on this device. Operating-system reduced-motion preferences disable animated prediction while still allowing report updates.

title: Clearer flight details
description: The Air panel shows feed observation age and explains estimated motion. Aircraft tooltips show report age and whether a marker is reported, estimated, stale or unknown. Selected flight details update to new reports and state the observation time.

title: Animation without extra provider calls
description: The aircraft overlay updates independently at up to 20 frames per second while visible; the full map and route do not redraw for every aircraft frame. Hidden/disabled layers stop visible animation work. The existing 30-second feed refresh and server cache remain; no additional provider polling or dependency is introduced.

title: Voice paths use the existing guarded UI controls
description: With GODSPEED open, say Press Air, then Turn on Animate aircraft or Turn off Animate aircraft. The recognized-text path uses the same native checkbox handler as a click and does not grant permissions. Browser tests verify named-control routing; microphone/acoustic trials remain separate.

title: Estimated movement and incomplete coverage
description: Motion between reports is a bounded speed/heading estimate and may differ from actual turns, acceleration or coverage gaps. Public feed data can be delayed or rate limited. Core must restart to supply observation timestamps; older Core responses stay stationary instead of inventing fresh positions. Real-device live display remains to validate after owner installation.
